prompts.basic: Use case: stylized-concept. Production platform fighter game sprite sheet exactly4 columns x4 rows,16 complete fullbody Shionne from Tales of Arise using reference outfit and detailed anime quality or higher. Pale pink very long ponytail, blueeyes, redhairornament, ornate blackgold bodice, white long dress split panels with crimson underskirt and white boots, long ornate blackgold rifle. Slim female anatomy, consistent model proportions. All SIDE/threequarter facingRIGHT toward opponent, NOT front portrait. True transparent background; no text/grid/ground/extrafigures/glows/bullets or attack trails. Each complete hair, rifle and boot fits in its cell with20%clear margins, no crosscelloverlap. Reading cells0..15: relaxed rightfacing combatidle holding rifle muzzle downforward; walkright contact; walk passing; oppositewalkcontact; oppositewalkpassing; runningextension; runningcompression; opposite runningextension; opposite runningcompression; dashstart leaningforward; braking; crouchwithrifle; turnlookingright; jumpsquat; risingjump riflebesideshoulder; doublejump rifleslungforward. Exactly16 fullfigures, noemptycells. Sharp clean detailed linework clothfolds and goldrifle, no baked effects.

prompts.attacks:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet of Shionne from Tales of Arise, EXACT identity and body proportions from reference image 1 (approved game basic sheet). Reference image 2 supplies move ideas. Slim young woman, long pale pink ponytail, red hair ornament, white/red layered dress, black and gold corset, white boots, ornate long black/gold rifle. Keep her face, head size, neck, torso, skirt, limbs and boots identical in scale across cells. Detailed clean anime cel shading. True transparent background. Exactly 16 isolated FULL-BODY poses arranged in a regular 4x4 grid on 1536x1024. Each entire figure and rifle must stay inside its own cell, with at least 25 pixels transparent gap on every side. Every image has the same body scale, not normalized by weapon length. Face/action RIGHT except explicit back attacks. NO text, labels, panels, ground, dummy, projectiles, muzzle flash, magic, trails, glow, dust or shadows. Only the character's whole body and held equipment. Cell0 identical neutral from first reference, to calibrate scale. Do NOT redesign or regenerate the neutral identity.
Remaining cells1-15 in row-major order: 1 jab with rifle butt at waist; 2 return butt strike with body twisting opposite; 3 close-range rifle braced for point-blank shot; 4 long horizontal rifle sweep across upper body; 5 upward butt strike standing tall, rifle high; 6 low front slide kick with rifle drawn behind; 7 forward shoulder rush holding rifle sideways; 8 charged wide forward rifle shot stance kneeling one knee, both hands aim at chest level; 9 upward aimed shot with straight upright torso and rifle pointing vertically; 10 low crouched gravity casting palm down with rifle lowered behind; 11 NEUTRAL AIR: airborne with knees tucked unevenly and ONE hand twirling rifle horizontally away from her body, gun-spin distinct from any sword/body spin; 12 forward air: airborne straight forward barrel thrust, legs stretched behind; 13 back air: looking and shooting behind her to LEFT, front knee raised; 14 up air: airborne vertical rifle shot held one-handed above, extended body and trailing skirt; 15 down air: both hands aim rifle down-front at 60 degrees, body leans back from recoil, legs apart. These must be 15 visibly different full-body poses; no generic spinning pose repeated.
